map.反馈控制系统在阶跃/斜坡/抛物线输入下的稳态误差 e_ss，由系统型别与开环增益: The steady-state error e_ss of a feedback control system under step/ramp/parabolic inputs, determined by system type and open-loop gain.
map.0 型单位反馈系统在单位阶跃输入下的稳态误差。: The steady-state error of a type-0 unity-feedback system under a unit step input.
map.比例控制 Kp 求单位阶跃稳态误差 ess = 1/(1+Kp)。: For proportional control Kp, the unit-step steady-state error ess = 1/(1+Kp).
map.系统精度与增益权衡。: Trade-off between system accuracy and gain.
map.对比不同 Kp 的静差。: Compare the static error for different Kp.
map.稳态误差 ess = 1/(1+9) = 0.10，即终值偏差 10%；Kp 升: Steady-state error ess = 1/(1+9) = 0.10, i.e. a 10% final-value deviation; raising Kp to 99 gives ess~1%.
map.纯比例必有静差，加入积分可使阶跃 ess 趋于 0，但可能影响稳定性。: Pure proportional control always has a static error; adding integral drives the step ess toward 0, but may affect stability.
map.为什么纯比例有静差？: Why does pure proportional control have a static error?
map.为维持输出需一定误差驱动控制器，零误差则无驱动，故存在稳态偏差。: To maintain the output the controller needs a certain error to drive it; with zero error there is no drive, so a steady-state deviation remains.
map.Kp 越大静差越小？: Does a larger Kp give a smaller static error?
map.是，ess=1/(1+Kp) 随 Kp 增大而减小，但过大会引发振荡。: Yes, ess=1/(1+Kp) decreases as Kp increases, but too large a value can cause oscillation.
